title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: On reaching its round limit the command asserted that work remained. The next round never ran, so it could not know.

highlights.title: The limit message states the limit, not a guess
highlights.description: On the reference project the round following the last productive one found nothing at all. What the command knows is that it stopped on the limit, so that is what it says.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Reaching the round limit is reported as reaching the limit, with the reason to run it again left as a question rather than an assertion.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: A collision between the sweep removing an already unused import and the cascade removing a freshly orphaned one would make VS Code reject the whole edit in silence. The cascade excludes the already dead ones by construction, and on the reference project not one of the 26 files carrying cascade imports has a range touching a family cut.
